summary: REQ-21 appears implemented via two separate outline Buttons that scroll to distinct section IDs. REQ-20 is partially implemented: Success Criteria tab triggers have hover/focus/active styles, and Impact/90-Day buttons have hover/focus styles, but a clearly distinct persistent selected/active state for the Impact/90-Day controls is not evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add clear hover, focus, and selected (active) visual states for all tab buttons in the Success Criteria module (including the “Impact” and “90-Day Plan” buttons), with selected styling distinct from hover, working in light and dark modes.
missing_requirements.reason: The four Success Criteria TabsTriggers have hover/focus-visible and a selected state via `[data-state="active"]`, but the separate “Impact” and “90-Day Plan” controls are implemented as plain Buttons with hover/focus-visible styling only; no persistent selected/active styling (distinct from hover) is shown for those controls.

hallucinated_features.description: Global theme/palette changes (professional blue-slate OKLCH palette) beyond adding tab/button interaction states.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest focuses on hover/focus/selected states and distinct Impact vs 90-Day controls; the diff shows extensive changes to CSS variables for colors/backgrounds/cards/charts, which is broader than requested UI interaction styling.

hallucinated_features.description: Addition of a new “Reviews” section and related navigation/content references.
hallucinated_features.reason: Non-goals explicitly state not to add new sections; the diff includes updates in a project summary file claiming a new Reviews section/component and navigation support.
